page_title: ROM 2-3 BOL | AS Roma v Bologna 10/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Gianluca Manganiello shows a yellow card to Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
87' Gianluca Manganiello shows a yellow card to Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) for a tough tackle.
87' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) sees a yellow card from Gianluca Manganiello after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
84' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Riccardo Orsolini is replaced by Nicolo Casale (Bologna).
82' 2 - 3 Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) receives an accurate low pass inside the box and slams the ball home into the top left corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
80' Substitution. Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) has come on for Manu Kone.
77' 1 - 3 Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets inside the left post.
77' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
75' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
74' Celebrations are cut short for Bologna as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
74' The Bologna players halt their celebrations as referee Gianluca Manganiello makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
72' Goal! Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:3.
72' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
71' AS Roma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
68' A yellow card for a tackle by Juan Miranda (Bologna). Gianluca Manganiello doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
68' Juan Miranda (Bologna) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. AS Roma are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Santiago Castro departs the field of play to be replaced by Thijs Dallinga (Bologna).
67' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) replacing Jens Odgaard.
66' 1 - 2 Goal! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Mile Svilar. He makes it 1:2.
63' 1 - 1 Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header into the roof of the net. Excellent finish.
61' Samuel Dahl (AS Roma) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Zeki Celik.
61' Here is a change. Niccolo Pisilli is going off and Ivan Juric gives the last tactical orders to Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
60' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) sends the resulting free kick a whisker wide of the left post!
58' The resulting corner from Juan Miranda (Bologna) comes to nothing.
57' The referee signals a substitution. Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) is brought on as a substitute for Matias Soule.
57' Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
53' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) tackles a bit over-zealously and Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul. Bologna win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
50' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul after Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) hacks down one of his opponents. It's a free kick to Bologna, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
49' The corner kick from Matias Soule (AS Roma) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
46' Here comes a substitution. Lorenzo De Silvestri is given a rest as he is replaced by Stefan Posch (Bologna).
46' The whistle blows and Gianluca Manganiello starts the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Gianluca Manganiello didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
41' It looks like Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) saw red with that tackle. Gianluca Manganiello won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. AS Roma have a free kick.
36' Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post.
35' The game is interrupted as Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) is flagged offside.
34' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Lukasz Skorupski is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
33' Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul after Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. AS Roma earn a free kick.
31' Matias Soule (AS Roma) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only crashes against the crossbar.
30' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.

30' Santiago Castro (Bologna) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Gianluca Manganiello no option but to blow his whistle. AS Roma are awarded a free kick.

25' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Riccardo Orsolini delivers a teasing cross from the resulting corner and the ball falls into the space where Santiago Castro (Bologna) is lurking. His precise shot from close range goes straight into the bottom left corner and it's 0:1.
25' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
25' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man. The referee signals a corner kick to Bologna.
23' Dan Ndoye is substituted due to injury. Vincenzo Italiano gives a chance to Jesper Karlsson (Bologna).
21' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
21' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
21' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
16' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Lukasz Skorupski makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
16' Remo Freuler (Bologna) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to AS Roma.
13' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle after Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Bologna win a free kick.
13' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Bologna have been awarded a free kick.
10' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul. Free kick. AS Roma will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
10' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. AS Roma will take a free kick near the side line.
9' The shot by Juan Miranda (Bologna) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Mile Svilar.

6' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Gianluca Manganiello with no other option than to blow for a foul. Bologna have a free kick.
4' Gianluca Manganiello couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Santiago Castro (Bologna) and blew his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to AS Roma.
4' Manu Kone (AS Roma) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
3' Rough tackle by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. AS Roma will take a free kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
AS Roma will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Gianluca Manganiello.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
Show lineups
Welcome to our live text coverage. We will try to provide you with a detailed image of what's happening on the pitch. There are only few moments left to the beginning of the match.
